[USER] User asked, "what is gravity."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gravity is a fundamental force of nature that causes objects with mass to attract each other, affecting everything from subatomic particles to galaxies. The strength of gravity depends on mass and distance, and it is described by the theory of general relativity developed by Albert Einstein.  
[USER] User asked, "what is life."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Life is characterized by biological processes such as growth, reproduction, adaptation, and metabolism, distinguishing living entities from non-living ones. There is ongoing debate about definitions of life, including the status of viruses and synthetic organisms.  
[USER] User asked, "who was minos."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Minos was a legendary king of Crete in Greek mythology, known for his wisdom and justice. He is associated with the Minotaur myth and the labyrinth built to imprison it, and he demanded tributes from Athens. He was said to have received laws from Zeus and contributed to Cretan law and culture.  
[USER] User asked, "what is ilovepdf.com."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] ilovepdf.com is a website offering online tools for working with PDF files, including conversion, merging, splitting, compressing, and editing PDFs. Some services are free, while others require payment.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources include:

4. Unity documentation - comprehensive reference for troubleshooting and learning.
